title: Smoking cigars at Lee Collins's Victory Club for tone
summary: Around 1950 Chace tried smoking cigars at the Victory Club, where Lee Collins welcomed young players, to get saliva for a special clarinet tone.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: yeah and that postulates the presence of saliva and i found that smoking a cigar was conducive to that and i tried it over at the victory club around 1950 when lee collins was holding forth over there and very happy to see anybody come in care to play he was very kind and gracious to all of us younger kids so i'd puff away on the cigar like crazy and try to gather up a whole bunch of saliva and get a special tone out of the clarinet i'm sorry to say it didn't work
maybe with an alfred system you would have had more luck you
